mission: Cockpit, night cycle. Desh at the long-range sensor display: 'Contact. Bearing three-one-five, parallel course. It's her.' Ben overlays both trajectories — convergence at Veranthos within hours of each other. She is not fleeing; she timed this. Torin watches the nav display with the expression of a man coming home and does not try to hide it.
why_now: The chapter needs a closing beat that sets the physical clock against the emotional one. Veraine visible, Torin orientating, countdown running — all three pressures converge at the same sensor dot.
conflict: There is nothing left to do except arrive. The group has spent seventeen chapters preparing for a confrontation that is now on a vector they cannot reshape. The scene is about who is watching what on the display.
turning_point: The two trajectories lock on the display. Ben sees Veraine is not fleeing — she timed this. The endgame is a date, not a guess.
opening_hook: Desh: 'Contact. Bearing three-one-five, parallel course.' A pause. 'It's her.'
closing_hook: Two ships converging on a world where the Force was torn a thousand years ago. Torin watches the nav display with the expression of a man coming home.
emotional_trajectory: Tactical alertness -> grim inevitability -> Torin's unsettling anticipation

stakes.personal: The endgame approaching — no more preparation time
stakes.interpersonal: Torin's anticipation against everyone else's dread

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — cockpit, sensor displays
sensory_details: A single bright dot on a parallel trajectory; Desh's professional calm holding its shape over concern; Torin's reflection overlaid on the viewport, the expression of a man coming home and not hiding it
action_beats: Desh tracks the sensor contact — a bright dot on the display, parallel course, Veraine's ship signature confirmed
Ben leans over the nav console and overlays both trajectories — they converge at Veranthos within hours of each other
Torin watches the nav display with the expression of a man coming home and doesn't try to hide it
notes: H18 planted — parallel course to Veranthos. Torin's expression is the chapter's final image. Anti-pattern: do not show Veraine directly; a sensor dot and a course overlay are enough. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, articulate 'convergence mirrors the thematic convergence' or any equivalent meta-sentence. He watches the overlay; he watches Torin's reflection; the chapter ends.
